product.title: Paris Private Custom Tour with a Local Guide, Hidden Gems & Highlights

description.text: Explore Paris on your own terms with a customized city visit with a local host. You'll get to spend two to eight hours with an expert Parisian, who can show you all sorts of off-the-beaten-path gems, from restaurants to shops to lesser-known museums. Stops include Colonne Vendôme, Place Vendôme. Your guide can also help you plan the rest of your trip, setting you up with itineraries suited to your own needs and interests. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Colonne Vendôme, Place Vendôme that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
